players.product: high-pressure hydrogen anneal (HPA) systems for advanced logic/DRAM nodes

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report, separate statements, reviewed by Woori Accounting): revenue KRW 78,062,950,623 against KRW 88,242,096,567 in H1 2025, operating profit KRW 44,450,222,401 against KRW 47,351,055,867; Q2 alone revenue KRW 46,122,709,544 (Q2 2025: KRW 51,346,984,517) with operating profit KRW 28,314,481,932 (KRW 28,643,683,818). GENI-SYS high-pressure hydrogen anneal equipment was KRW 69,624,089 thousand (89.2%) of H1 revenue, parts KRW 4,991,080 thousand and services KRW 3,447,782 thousand. Exports were KRW 66,195,844 thousand; domestic revenue rose to KRW 11,867,107 thousand from KRW 1,888,024 thousand, including KRW 10,400,000 thousand of domestic equipment sales after none in FY2025. H1 R&D spend KRW 2,853,158 thousand (3.65% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 rev KRW 78,062,950,623 (vs KRW 88,242,096,567); H1 OP KRW 44,450,222,401 (vs KRW 47,351,055,867); Q2 rev KRW 46,122,709,544, Q2 OP KRW 28,314,481,932; equipment 89.2% of revenue; domestic equipment KRW 10,400,000 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Customers and order build (DART half-year report): HPSP says it has shipped nearly 100 GENI-SYS tools to leading global system-semiconductor (logic/foundry) makers where they run in volume fabs, and also supplies domestic and overseas memory makers; through joint-development and process-development work with leading NAND and DRAM makers it has built a base for memory, has successfully completed pre-evaluation wafer tests with several global DRAM customers, is supporting volume-fab expansion at some of them and is working toward volume adoption at others. It withholds backlog details as customer-confidential. Customer concentration shifted: customer A took KRW 21,316,082 thousand in H1 2026 (none in H1 2025) while customers B, C and D fell to KRW 5,619,282 thousand, KRW 758,622 thousand and KRW 273,555 thousand from KRW 32,791,566 thousand, KRW 17,331,050 thousand and KRW 8,827,726 thousand. Inventory rose to KRW 41,909,098 thousand from KRW 15,957,076 thousand at end-2025, with work in progress at KRW 17,011,842 thousand against KRW 3,324,648 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Nearly 100 GENI-SYS tools shipped to logic makers; customer A KRW 21,316,082 thousand (H1 2025: 0); customers B/C/D KRW 5,619,282 / 758,622 / 273,555 thousand (vs 32,791,566 / 17,331,050 / 8,827,726 thousand); inventory KRW 41,909,098 thousand (vs KRW 15,957,076 thousand), WIP KRW 17,011,842 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Technology position (DART half-year report): GENI-SYS anneals at 250 ~ 450 degrees C and 1 ~ 25 ATM with 100% hydrogen or deuterium, against 600 ~ 1,100 degrees C and under 5% hydrogen for conventional furnace anneal, and the company says it is applied on 2nm to 16nm processes while conventional anneal cannot be used below 16nm; it calls GENI-SYS the only high-pressure hydrogen anneal tool certified to global pressure-vessel standards (PED, ASME, KGS) and says no competing tool is in volume production. It releases tools with new functions every 2-3 years, has a GENI-SYS installed at imec for logic, NAND and DRAM research, and holds a technical-advisory contract with POSTECH through 2027. Three patent cases (suits and trials) are pending, which management does not expect to be material.
quarterly_data.figure: 250 ~ 450 degrees C, 1 ~ 25 ATM, 100% hydrogen; applied on 2nm-16nm; new-function tools every 2-3 years; 3 patent cases pending
